name: astro-ph-researcher
description: Bilingual local astronomy workbench for Codex: literature, writing, learning, research plans and evidence-aware workflows.

interface.shortDescription: 双语天文工作台：文献、写作、新手、计划与研究资料
interface.longDescription: 3.4.0 为 Codex 提供本地双语窗口：文献检索与核验、写作项目、逐节编辑、作者确认、新手路径、研究计划、方法设备库和汇报 Markdown；附项目顶栏按钮安装器。保留原 DSH 与 9 个 skills。
defaultPrompt: Use $astro-ph-researcher:astro-literature-research to build a verifiable astronomy reading list.
Use $astro-ph-researcher:astro-code-writing to write reproducible astronomy code.
Use $astro-ph-researcher:astro-english-journal-writing to outline and revise my paper.
